preconditions.description: The dimensions of the museum must be between 3 and 1000.
The number of starting positions must be between 1 and the minimum of the product of n and m and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '.*' for row in museum for c in row)
preconditions.description: All cells in the museum must be either '.' or '*'.

preconditions.expression: all(museum[i][0] == '*' and museum[i][-1] == '*' for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All border cells of the museum must be impassable.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in start_positions)
preconditions.description: All starting positions must be within the bounds of the museum.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly k integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(num, int) and num >= 0 for num in output)
postconditions.description: Each output integer must be a non-negative number representing the maximum number of pictures seen.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == max_pictures(start_positions[i]) for i in range(k))
postconditions.description: Each output value must correspond to the maximum number of pictures Igor can see from the respective starting position.
